data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 substitutes a task-topology framework (verification-heavy vs synthesis-heavy) but never answers the problem's explicit second requirement: what evidence within a single evaluation distinguishes genuine reliability gain from mere checklist compliance that happens to track the right answer. Its mechanism only explains when a reliability gain occurs, not how to detect compliance-vs-gain within one evaluation, so it leaves the problem's distinguishing-evidence question unanswered.
